title: Formal unramifiedness data for the normalized root compositum
statement: Under the hypotheses of the uniformizer-root compositum theorem, the selected DVR T is an essentially finite type formally unramified A-algebra.

proof.text: The unit hypothesis makes e positive. Choose an irreducible q in U. Mapping the principal maximal ideal of B and using hindexU shows q^e is associated to pi in U; choose its unit factor w. The standard root algebra R=B[t]/(t^e-pi) is a DVR with maximal ideal (t). Map R to A by t -> theta and compose to rho:R->T.

Compatibility on B and the root equation give rho(t)^e=(j(q))^e*j(w). Unique factorization in the DVR T cancels the positive exponent in associatedness, yielding a unit y with j(q)*y=rho(t). Since j is local, rho(t) belongs to m(T); the formula m(R)=(t) proves rho local, and locality descends to R->A.

Apply the standard-root unramified model theorem with q,w,rho,y. Obtain an essentially finite type formally unramified DVR V over R and compatible maps V->T, Frac(V)->F and E->Frac(V). The image of E lies in the image of Frac(V), so hgen implies Algebra.adjoin A (range iV)=top.
Apply the arbitrary DVR unramified compositum base-change theorem to R,V,A,T and the compatible fraction-field map. It gives precisely essential finite type and formal unramifiedness of T over A.
